entities.name: PS mode 1 of operation
entities.description: UE registers only to EPS services with voice centric usage setting.

entities.name: PS mode 2 of operation
entities.description: UE registers only to EPS services with data centric usage setting.

entities.name: CS/PS mode 1 of operation
entities.description: UE registers to both EPS and non-EPS services with voice centric usage setting.

entities.name: CS/PS mode 2 of operation
entities.description: UE registers to both EPS and non-EPS services with data centric usage setting.

entities.name: CS fallback emergency call
entities.description: Procedure for establishing emergency call via CS fallback when UE cannot perform normal CS fallback.

entities.name: 1xCS fallback emergency call
entities.description: Procedure for establishing emergency call via 1xCS fallback when UE cannot perform normal 1xCS fallback.

entities.name: IMS voice not available
entities.description: Condition where UE cannot use IMS for voice services due to configuration or network indications.

entities.name: IMS voice available
entities.description: Condition where UE can use IMS for voice services when all IMS voice not available conditions evaluate to false.

entities.name: ATTACH ACCEPT message
entities.description: NAS message that may indicate IMS voice over PS session support.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message
entities.description: NAS message that may indicate IMS voice over PS session support.

relations.description: CS fallback emergency call procedure requires IMS voice not available condition.
1xCS fallback emergency call procedure requires IMS voice not available condition.
ATTACH ACCEPT message guards IMS voice not available condition through IMS voice over PS session support indication.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message guards IMS voice not available condition through IMS voice over PS session support indication.
When IMS voice not available conditions evaluate to false, IMS voice available condition is established.
